rows.question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_monthly_activity AS (
  SELECT
    ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'withdrawal' THEN -1 * ct.txn_amount
        ELSE ct.txn_amount
      END
    ) AS total_month_txn_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS transactions_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_activity_this_month
  FROM customer_transactions AS ct
  GROUP BY
    ct.customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER),
    CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)
),
customer_month_calendar_span AS (
  SELECT
    ctr.customer_id AS customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', month_iter.month_start) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', month_iter.month_start) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', month_iter.month_start) AS month_start_date,
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', date(date(month_iter.month_start, '+1 month'), '-1 day')) AS month_end_date
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        customer_id,
        DATE(MIN(txn_date)) AS min_txn_date,
        DATE(MAX(txn_date)) AS max_txn_date
      FROM customer_transactions
      GROUP BY customer_id
    ) AS ctr,
    (
      SELECT date('1970-01-01', '+' || (n0.n + n1.n*10 + n2.n*100 + n3.n*1000) || ' months') AS month_start
      FROM
        (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) n0,
        (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) n1,
        (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) n2,
        (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) n3
    ) AS month_iter
  WHERE
    month_iter.month_start >= date(substr(ctr.min_txn_date,1,10), 'start of month')
    AND month_iter.month_start <= date(substr(ctr.max_txn_date,1,10), 'start of month')
),
customer_txn_rowlevel AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date AS txn_date,
    txn_type,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(trim(txn_type)) IN ('withdrawal','debit','dr') THEN -ABS(txn_amount)
      WHEN lower(trim(txn_type)) IN ('deposit','credit','cr') THEN ABS(txn_amount)
      ELSE txn_amount
    END AS txn_amount_signed,
    txn_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN txn_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
      WHEN txn_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]' THEN
        printf('20%02d-%02d-%02d', substr(txn_date,7,2), substr(txn_date,4,2), substr(txn_date,1,2))
      WHEN txn_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN
        printf('%04d-%02d-%02d', substr(txn_date,7,4), substr(txn_date,4,2), substr(txn_date,1,2))
      WHEN txn_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN
        printf('%04d-%02d-%02d', substr(txn_date,7,4), substr(txn_date,1,2), substr(txn_date,4,2))
      ELSE txn_date
    END AS txn_date_parsed
  FROM customer_transactions
)
SELECT
  cms.customer_id,
  cms.year,
  cms.month,
  cms.month_start_date,
  cms.month_end_date,
  -- closing_balance: running sum of monthly deltas up to and including this month
  SUM(COALESCE(cma.total_month_txn_amount, 0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY cms.customer_id
    ORDER BY cms.year, cms.month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS closing_balance,
  -- monthly_change: difference between this month's total and prior month's total
  (COALESCE(cma.total_month_txn_amount, 0)
   - LAG(COALESCE(cma.total_month_txn_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cms.customer_id ORDER BY cms.year, cms.month)
  ) AS monthly_change,
  -- cumulative_balance is same as closing_balance
  SUM(COALESCE(cma.total_month_txn_amount, 0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY cms.customer_id
    ORDER BY cms.year, cms.month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_balance,
  COALESCE(cma.has_activity_this_month, 0) AS has_activity_this_month
FROM customer_month_calendar_span AS cms
LEFT JOIN customer_monthly_activity AS cma
  ON cms.customer_id = cma.customer_id
  AND cms.year = cma.year
  AND cms.month = cma.month
ORDER BY cms.customer_id ASC, cms.year ASC, cms.month ASC

rows.question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_monthly_balances_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    ct.customer_id,
    substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7) AS month_label,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount
        WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'withdrawal' THEN -ct.txn_amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS month_end_balance
  FROM customer_transactions AS ct
  WHERE ct.txn_date LIKE '2020-%'
  GROUP BY ct.customer_id, substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7)
),
all_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
months AS (
  SELECT '2020-01' AS month_label UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-11' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-12'
),
monthly_agg AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_label,
    SUM(CASE WHEN coalesce(b.month_end_balance,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_customer_count,
    AVG(coalesce(b.month_end_balance,0)) AS average_month_end_balance
  FROM months m
  CROSS JOIN all_customers c
  LEFT JOIN customer_monthly_balances_2020 b
    ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id AND b.month_label = m.month_label
  GROUP BY m.month_label
),
ranked_desc AS (
  SELECT
    month_label, positive_customer_count, average_month_end_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customer_count DESC, month_label ASC) AS rn
  FROM monthly_agg
),
ranked_asc AS (
  SELECT
    month_label, positive_customer_count, average_month_end_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customer_count ASC, month_label ASC) AS rn
  FROM monthly_agg
)
SELECT
  l.month_label AS month_label_largest,
  l.positive_customer_count AS positive_customer_count_largest,
  l.average_month_end_balance AS average_month_end_balance_largest,
  s.month_label AS month_label_smallest,
  s.positive_customer_count AS positive_customer_count_smallest,
  s.average_month_end_balance AS average_month_end_balance_smallest,
  (l.average_month_end_balance - s.average_month_end_balance) AS average_difference
FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked_desc WHERE rn = 1) l
CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked_asc WHERE rn = 1) s

rows.question: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month’s closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Next, determine the most recent month’s growth rate by comparing its closing balance to the prior month’s balance, treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative, and if the previous month’s balance is zero, the growth rate should be the current month’s balance multiplied by 100. Finally, compute the percentage of customers whose most recent month shows a growth rate of more than 5%.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_txn_normalized AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id,
  ct.txn_date AS txn_date_parsed,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 10)) AS INTEGER) AS txn_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 10)) AS INTEGER) AS txn_month,
  date(substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 10), 'start of month') AS month_start_date,
  ct.txn_type,
  ct.txn_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount
    ELSE -ct.txn_amount
  END AS signed_amount
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
),
customer_monthly_net_60 AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  -- month_start_date as first day of month in YYYY-MM-DD using txn_date (assumes txn_date stored as YYYY-MM-DD or parseable)
  date(substr(ct.txn_date,1,4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)) || '-01') AS month_start_date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_month,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) IN ('deposit') THEN ct.txn_amount
      WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) IN ('withdrawal') THEN -ct.txn_amount
      ELSE ct.txn_amount
    END
  ) AS monthly_net
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY
  ct.customer_id,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER),
  CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS overall_percentage_customers_over_5pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    -- most recent month's closing balance
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN closing_balance END) AS most_recent_closing_balance,
    -- prior month's closing balance (if none, will be NULL -> treat as 0 below)
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 2 THEN closing_balance END) AS prior_closing_balance,
    -- compute growth_rate per customer according to rules
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 2 THEN closing_balance END) IS NULL THEN
        -- only one month exists -> prior_closing_balance = 0 -> use special rule
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN closing_balance END) * 100.0
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 2 THEN closing_balance END) = 0 THEN
        -- prior balance zero -> special rule
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN closing_balance END) * 100.0
      ELSE
        -- normal percentage change
        (MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN closing_balance END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 2 THEN closing_balance END))
        / MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 2 THEN closing_balance END)
    END AS growth_rate
  FROM (
    -- compute closing balances and row numbers per customer ordered by month (desc to pick most recent as rn_desc=1)
    SELECT
      customer_id,
      month_start_date,
      monthly_net,
      SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_year, txn_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start_date DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM customer_monthly_net_60
  ) t
  GROUP BY customer_id
) per_customer

rows.question: For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_transaction_rows AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    -- normalize txn_date to YYYY-MM-DD when already in that form; otherwise keep as-is (schema examples are YYYY-MM-DD)
    txn_date,
    txn_type,
    CASE
      WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
      WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
      ELSE txn_amount
    END AS signed_txn_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
),
months_in_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    printf('%04d-%02d', CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER), CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER)) AS calendar_month,
    date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date)) AS month_first_day,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_order
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY calendar_month, month_first_day, month_order
),
-- build for each customer and each month_end (last day of month for months they have activity) the cumulative balance up to that month_end
customer_monthly_cumulative_balance AS (
  SELECT
    ct.customer_id,
    m.calendar_month,
    m.month_order,
    -- month_end_date is the last day of that month
    date(m.month_first_day, '+1 month', '-1 day') AS month_end_date,
    (
      SELECT IFNULL(SUM(t.signed_txn_amount),0)
      FROM customer_transaction_rows t
      WHERE t.customer_id = ct.customer_id
        AND date(t.txn_date) <= date(date(m.month_first_day, '+1 month', '-1 day'))
    ) AS cumulative_balance
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transaction_rows) AS ct
  JOIN
    months_in_transactions AS m
    ON 1=1
  -- limit the month rows per customer to months where that customer had any txn in that month (to avoid creating unrelated months)
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM customer_transaction_rows t2
    WHERE t2.customer_id = ct.customer_id
      AND printf('%04d-%02d', CAST(strftime('%Y', t2.txn_date) AS INTEGER), CAST(strftime('%m', t2.txn_date) AS INTEGER)) = m.calendar_month
  )
),
-- For each month (m), we want the total of all customers' balances as of the 1st of that month,
-- which equals the cumulative_balance computed up through the previous month's end (month_order - 1).
-- So we need to join months_in_transactions (m) to customer_monthly_cumulative_balance (c) where c.month_order = m.month_order - 1
final_months AS (
  SELECT
    m.calendar_month AS month,
    m.month_first_day AS as_of_date,
    m.month_order
  FROM months_in_transactions m
)
SELECT
  f.month,
  f.as_of_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.cumulative_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE c.cumulative_balance END) AS total_adjusted_balance
FROM final_months f
LEFT JOIN customer_monthly_cumulative_balance c
  ON c.month_order = f.month_order - 1
GROUP BY f.month_order, f.month, f.as_of_date
-- Exclude the first month in the data (it's only baseline)
HAVING f.month_order > (SELECT MIN(month_order) FROM months_in_transactions)
ORDER BY f.month_order ASC

rows.question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_daily_end_of_day_balance AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  ct.txn_date AS txn_date,
  -- compute end-of-day balance by summing signed amounts up to and including that date per customer
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount
        ELSE -t.txn_amount
      END
    ), 0)
    FROM customer_transactions AS t
    WHERE t.customer_id = ct.customer_id
      AND date(t.txn_date) <= date(ct.txn_date)
  ) AS end_of_day_balance
FROM
  customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY
  ct.customer_id,
  ct.txn_date
),
customer_first_transaction_month AS (
SELECT
  customer_id,
  substr(min(txn_date), 1, 7) AS baseline_month
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_daily_net_change AS (
SELECT
  customer_id,
  date(substr(txn_date, 1, 10)) AS date,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
      ELSE -txn_amount
    END
  ) AS daily_net_change
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id, date(substr(txn_date, 1, 10))
),
customer_daily_eod_balance AS (
SELECT
  d.customer_id,
  d.date,
  -- running end-of-day balance: cumulative sum of daily_net_change per customer ordered by date
  (SELECT SUM(d2.daily_net_change)
   FROM customer_daily_net_change d2
   WHERE d2.customer_id = d.customer_id
     AND date(d2.date) <= date(d.date)
  ) AS end_of_day_balance,
  -- flag if the date is in the same month as the customer's first transaction month
  (CASE
     WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', d.date) = strftime('%Y-%m', (
         SELECT MIN(date) FROM customer_daily_net_change d3 WHERE d3.customer_id = d.customer_id
     )) THEN 1 ELSE 0
   END) AS is_first_txn_month
FROM customer_daily_net_change d
),
customer_daily_30d_rolling_avg_balance AS (
SELECT
  d.customer_id AS customer_id,
  d.date AS txn_date,
  AVG(d.end_of_day_balance) OVER (
    PARTITION BY d.customer_id
    ORDER BY d.date
    ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS rolling_30d_avg_balance
FROM customer_daily_eod_balance d
WHERE d.end_of_day_balance IS NOT NULL
  -- ensure at least 30 days available ending on txn_date by checking row_number over partition
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(1)
    FROM customer_daily_eod_balance d2
    WHERE d2.customer_id = d.customer_id
      AND d2.date BETWEEN date(d.date, '-29 days') AND d.date
      AND d2.end_of_day_balance IS NOT NULL
  ) = 30
)
SELECT
  calendar_month,
  SUM(customer_monthly_max_30d_avg) AS sum_of_customer_monthly_max_30d_avg_balance
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    substr(r.txn_date,1,7) AS calendar_month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rolling_30d_avg_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.rolling_30d_avg_balance END) AS customer_monthly_max_30d_avg
  FROM customer_daily_30d_rolling_avg_balance r
  LEFT JOIN customer_first_transaction_month f
    ON r.customer_id = f.customer_id
  WHERE substr(r.txn_date,1,7) <> f.baseline_month
  GROUP BY r.customer_id, substr(r.txn_date,1,7)
) per_customer_month
GROUP BY calendar_month
ORDER BY calendar_month ASC

rows.question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_daily_txn AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(txn_date) AS txn_date,
    SUM(txn_amount) AS daily_txn_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, date(txn_date)
),
customer_date_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(MIN(txn_date)) AS min_txn_date,
    date(MAX(txn_date)) AS max_txn_date,
    CAST(julianday(MAX(txn_date)) - julianday(MIN(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS span_days
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
max_span AS (
  SELECT MAX(cast(julianday(max_txn) - julianday(min_txn) AS INTEGER)) AS max_span FROM (
    SELECT MIN(txn_date) AS min_txn, MAX(txn_date) AS max_txn, customer_id
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
  )
),
nums AS (
  WITH RECURSIVE seq(n) AS (
    SELECT 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n+1 FROM seq WHERE n < (SELECT COALESCE(max_span,0) FROM max_span)
  )
  SELECT n FROM seq
),
customer_calendar AS (
  SELECT
    d.customer_id,
    date(d.min_txn_date, '+' || n.n || ' days') AS calendar_date
  FROM customer_date_ranges d
  JOIN nums n ON n.n <= d.span_days
),
customer_daily_sequence AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.calendar_date,
    COALESCE(t.daily_txn_amount, 0) AS daily_txn_amount
  FROM customer_calendar c
  LEFT JOIN customer_daily_txn t
    ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND t.txn_date = c.calendar_date
),
customer_running_balance AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    calendar_date,
    SUM(daily_txn_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY calendar_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS raw_balance
  FROM customer_daily_sequence
),
customer_daily_balance_nonneg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    calendar_date,
    CASE WHEN raw_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE raw_balance END AS balance
  FROM customer_running_balance
),
customer_monthly_max AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', calendar_date) AS month,
    MAX(balance) AS customer_month_max
  FROM customer_daily_balance_nonneg
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', calendar_date)
)
SELECT
  month,
  SUM(customer_month_max) AS monthly_total_max_daily_balance
FROM customer_monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

rows.question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH shopping_cart_pages_with_product AS (
SELECT
  page_id,
  page_name,
  product_id,
  product_category
FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
shopping_cart_page_events_with_names AS (
SELECT
  e.visit_id,
  e.cookie_id,
  e.page_id,
  h.product_id,
  e.event_type,
  t.event_name,
  e.sequence_number,
  e.event_time
FROM shopping_cart_events e
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy h
  ON e.page_id = h.page_id
JOIN shopping_cart_event_identifier t
  ON e.event_type = t.event_type
WHERE h.product_id IS NOT NULL
),
shopping_cart_events_enriched AS (
SELECT
  e.visit_id AS visit_id,
  e.cookie_id AS cookie_id,
  e.page_id AS page_id,
  p.product_id AS product_id,
  p.page_name AS page_name,
  e.event_type AS event_type,
  t.event_name AS event_name,
  e.sequence_number AS sequence_number,
  e.event_time AS event_time
FROM shopping_cart_events e
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p
  ON e.page_id = p.page_id
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_event_identifier t
  ON e.event_type = t.event_type
WHERE p.product_id IS NOT NULL
),
product_page_mapping AS (
SELECT
  page_id,
  page_name,
  product_id,
  product_category
FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
product_event_counts_by_visit_and_cookie AS (
SELECT
  sce.product_id AS product_id,
  sce.visit_id AS visit_id,
  sce.cookie_id AS cookie_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sce.event_name = 'Page View' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS page_view_count,
